basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (OBG), Senior Resident (Radiology), Senior Resident (ENT)
basic_details.short_information: Babu Jagjivan Ram Memorial Hospital (BJRMH), Delhi, has invited applications for 6 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 1(729)/BJRMH/Estt./WII/SRs/2026-27/7311. The posts include Senior Resident (OBG), Senior Resident (Radiology), Senior Resident (ENT). Selection is through a walk-in interview on 2 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Ad-hoc appointment for 89 days initially or till recruitment of Senior Resident Doctors by centralized committee, whichever is earlier Selected candidates must join within 05 days of issue of offer letter, otherwise the offer stands automatically cancelled One SR (ENT) post is to be appointed against the vacant post of Specialist (ENT)

content_sections.heading: How Will BJRMH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Verification of original certificates/documents at the time of interview Walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at the Administrative Block

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form Self-attested copies: Date of Birth Certificate (Xth Class), DMC Registration certificate, Mark sheets of all years Self-attested copies: Internship completion certificate, Attempt Certificate, Address Proof Physically handicapped certificate and Caste certificate (if applicable) Original certificates/documents for verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BJRMH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report at the Administrative Block on 2 December 2026 at 10.00 AM; enrollment is from 10.00 AM to 12.00 noon only. Bring the application form printed with the notice, filled in. Bring self-attested copies of testimonials. Bring original certificates/documents for verification at the interview.
